content: Root cause: The bug was caused by an incorrect implementation of the linked list management for preallocated barriers in the `i915_active_acquire_preallocate_barrier` function. Specifically, only the first and last nodes were being added to the `ref->preallocated_barriers`, which resulted in an incomplete list and potential issues when accessing or processing the barriers. The patch corrects this by properly managing the linked list to ensure all nodes are appended correctly.
